ei.title: Innovative Ways to Handle Fashion Returns
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more (A)[innovative / conservative] in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are (B)[channelled / ignored] through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of (C)[dedicated / abandoned] in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② innovative - channelled - dedicated = 원문 일치

❌ ① conservative: 소매업체가 '보수적'이 아닌 '혁신적'으로 변하고 있음

❌ ③ ignored/abandoned: 반품을 '무시'하고 전용 공간을 '폐기'하는 것은 맥락과 반대

❌ ④ conservative/ignored/abandoned: 세 단어 모두 원문과 불일치

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be (A)[tempted / forced] to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to (B)[virtually / physically] try on products to check fit and (C)[suitability / inadequacy] prior to purchase. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① tempted - virtually - suitability = 원문 일치

❌ ② forced: 고객이 '강요받는'게 아니라 '유혹받는' 것

❌ ③ physically/inadequacy: 가상 착용을 '물리적'으로, 적합성 대신 '부적합성'은 모순

❌ ④ forced/physically/inadequacy: 세 단어 모두 원문과 불일치

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ improve - satisfaction - reducing = 원문 일치

❌ ① worsen: 이익과 만족도를 '악화'시키는 것이 아니라 '향상'시키는 것

❌ ② dissatisfaction: 고객 '불만족'이 아닌 '만족도'를 높이는 것

❌ ④ worsen/dissatisfaction/increasing: 세 단어 모두 맥락과 반대

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more ①<u>innovative</u> in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most ②<u>cost-ineffective</u> route. One example of this is the introduction of ③<u>dedicated</u> in-store areas, supported by ④<u>advanced</u> AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① innovative: 소매업체가 혁신적으로 변하고 있다 → 적절

② cost-ineffective: '비효율적인' 경로 → 가장 비용 효율적인 경로를 찾는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답

③ dedicated: 전용 매장 공간 도입 → 적절

④ advanced: 첨단 AI 기술 지원 → 적절

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be ①<u>tempted</u> to make ②<u>additional</u> purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to ③<u>virtually</u> try on products to check fit and ④<u>unsuitability</u> prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① tempted: 추가 구매를 유혹받을 수 있다 → 적절

② additional: 추가 구매를 할 수 있다 → 적절

③ virtually: 가상으로 제품을 착용해볼 수 있다 → 적절

④ unsuitability: '부적합성'을 확인 → 착용감과 적합성을 확인하는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the ①<u>collection</u> of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a ②<u>free</u> return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should ③<u>undermine</u> both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, ④<u>reducing</u> the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① collection: 온라인 주문 수령 → 적절

② free: 무료 반품을 처리하러 매장에 방문 → 적절

③ undermine: 수익 마진과 만족도를 '약화'시키는 것 → 향상시키는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답

④ reducing: 재정적 위험을 줄이면서 → 적절

det.analysis:

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. det.korean: 무료 반품 처리를 위해 매장에 온 고객이 추가 구매를 유혹받는 맥락
det.analysis:
① tempted: 유혹받은 — 매장 방문 시 추가 구매 충동을 느끼는 맥락 ←정답

② refused: 거부된 — 추가 구매를 거절당한다는 맥락과 무관

③ prohibited: 금지된 — 강제 금지 의미로 부적합

④ discouraged: 낙담된 — 부정적 감정으로 전혀 다른 의미
det.tip: be tempted to=~하고 싶은 마음이 생기다, 충동을 느끼다

det.korean: 옴니채널 전략이 수익 마진과 고객 만족도를 개선해야 한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① confusion: 혼란 — 전략이 혼란을 높이는 것은 맥락과 반대

② frustration: 좌절 — 부정적 결과 맥락으로 부적합

③ satisfaction: 만족도 — 이익 마진과 고객 '만족도' 향상이 목표 ←정답

④ indifference: 무관심 — 고객 반응으로 부정적 의미

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more <u>innovative</u> in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 innovative와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
① traditional: 전통적인 — innovative와 반대 의미

② creative: 창의적인 — 새로운 방식을 도입하는 innovative와 가장 가까운 의미 ←정답

③ efficient: 효율적인 — 방법의 속성이지 혁신성과 다름

④ profitable: 수익성 있는 — 결과 중심 단어로 의미 다름

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of <u>dedicated</u> in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 dedicated와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
① shared: 공유된 — 전용(한 목적만)과 반대 의미

② exclusive: 독점적인, 전용의 — 특정 목적에만 사용된다는 의미로 가장 가까움 ←정답

③ general: 일반적인 — 전용과 반대, 두루 쓰이는 의미

④ temporary: 일시적인 — 시간 관련 개념으로 dedicated와 무관

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in <u>addressing</u> the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 addressing와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
① avoiding: 회피하다 — 문제를 피하는 의미로 addressing과 반대

② ignoring: 무시하다 — 문제를 외면하는 의미로 반대

③ dealing with: 다루다, 처리하다 — address a problem=deal with으로 가장 가까움 ←정답

④ worsening: 악화시키다 — 문제를 악화시키는 부정적 의미

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the <u>increasing</u> returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 increasing과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
① growing: 증가하는 — increasing과 같은 의미로 반의어 아님

② rising: 상승하는 — 역시 증가 방향이라 반의어 아님

③ declining: 감소하는 — increasing(증가)의 정반대 의미 ←정답

④ expanding: 확장하는 — 증가 방향이라 반의어 아님

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability <u>prior</u> to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 prior와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
① before: ~전에 — prior와 같은 '이전' 의미로 반의어 아님

② earlier: 더 이른 — 역시 앞선 시점을 뜻해 반의어 아님

③ advance: 사전의, 앞선 — prior와 유사한 의미

④ subsequent: 이후의, 그 뒤의 — prior(이전의)와 정반대 의미 ←정답

questions.passage:
(A) Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders.

(B) An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to <u>process</u> a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 process와 가장 가까운 의미로 쓰인 것은?

det.korean: process: (B) 처리하다(반품 처리) / ①처리하다(행정) ②분석하다 ③가공하다 ④소화하다
det.analysis:
본문의 process는 '반품을 (행정적으로) 처리하다'라는 의미.

① process your refund request: 환불 요청을 처리하다 — 같은 행정적 처리 의미 ←정답

② process the data: 데이터를 분석/처리 — 정보 처리 의미로 다름

③ process raw materials: 원자재를 가공하다 — 물리적 변환 의미

④ process the news emotionally: 충격을 감정적으로 소화하다 — 심리적 의미

ch: It takes a few days to process your refund request.
Scientists will process the data to find meaningful patterns.
The factory uses machines to process raw materials into finished goods.
She found it hard to process the shocking news emotionally.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the process of moving goods back from customers to sellers or manufacturers for reuse, repair, or disposal"

det.korean: 고객에서 판매자/제조사로 제품을 돌려보내는 과정 = 역물류
det.analysis:
① omni-channel: 온·오프라인 통합 채널 전략 — 정의와 다름

② operating profit: 영업이익 — 재무 용어로 정의와 무관

③ customer satisfaction: 고객 만족도 — 정의와 무관

④ reverse logistics: 역물류 — 고객→판매자/제조사 방향으로 반품·재활용·폐기를 위해 이동하는 과정 ←정답

questions.passage: One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, __________ (support) by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders.

det.analysis: in-store areas를 수식하는 분사구문. 공간이 AI 기술에 의해 '지원받는' 수동적 의미이므로 support → supported(과거분사)

questions.passage: Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, __________ (reduce) the financial risk posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 앞 절의 결과/부대상황을 나타내는 분사구문. 주어(Omni-channel initiatives)가 위험을 줄이는 능동적 의미이므로 reduce → reducing(현재분사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 구매 전에 온라인으로 착용해보아 적합성을 확인한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① prior to purchase: 구매 전 — 제품 착용감과 적합성을 구매 '전에' 미리 확인 ←정답

② after the sale: 판매 후 — 구매 결정 전 사전 확인 맥락과 반대

③ during delivery: 배송 중 — 이미 구매 완료 시점이라 맥락 부적합

questions.passage: Fashion retailers are becoming more innovative in addressing the increasing returns issue, including the implementation of reverse logistics strategies, by which returns are channelled through the most cost-effective route. One example of this is the introduction of dedicated in-store areas, supported by advanced AI technology, for both online and offline returns and the collection of online orders. An advantage of this is that online customers, going into a store to process a free return, may be tempted to make additional purchases while there. Improved technology is also being used to allow online customers to virtually try on products to check fit and suitability prior to purchase. Omni-channel initiatives, such as these, should improve both operating profit margins and customer satisfaction, reducing the __________ posed by the increasing rate of returns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 옴니채널 전략이 증가하는 반품률로 인한 재정적 위험을 줄인다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① operating profit margins: 영업이익 마진 — 줄이는 것이 아니라 향상시키는 대상

② financial risk: 재정적 위험 — 반품률 증가로 인한 '재정적 위험'을 줄이는 것 ←정답

③ customer satisfaction: 고객 만족도 — 줄이는 것이 아니라 향상시키는 대상

④ reverse logistics: 역물류 — 전략의 이름이지 줄이는 대상이 아님
det.tip: financial risk=재정적 위험, pose a risk=위험을 초래하다
